display_title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-INFRA-01 Enhancing physical protection of critical infrastructures – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-INFRA-01 Enhancing physical protection of critical infrastructures
executive_summary: Develops physical-security risk assessment, protective tools, incident procedures and practitioner training for essential infrastructure. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 12 million, with around EUR 6 million expected per project. Opening 2027-05-05, full proposal deadline 2027-11-04 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 6, pp. 87–90, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to TSO Innovation Alliance. Specific conditions require at least three relevant practitioner beneficiaries and list critical-infrastructure operators. A Dutch TSO can take that funded route, subject to the China-control and security conditions. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. The helper supplied both project dates from 1 January 2027 using its 36-month default.
